description: Current Kin ecosystem topology and repo ownership map.

naming.summary: Firelock (the company) builds Kin (the semantic repo and collaboration substrate). KinLab is the hosted collaboration product; @kinlab is the shared package and registry scope.

product.name: Kin
product.descriptor: The semantic repo and collaboration substrate, a graph-native code repository for people and AI agents.

hostedProduct.name: KinLab
hostedProduct.descriptor: The hosted collaboration and control-plane product.

repos.name: kin-vfs
repos.note: Defocused by the founder on 2026-09-11. Libc-interception filesystem projection via LD_PRELOAD and DYLD; the repository stays public and deprecated for reference, and its binaries leave the shipped release archives. kin-vfs-core is kept as a crate inside kin's own workspace for the projection engine. `kin run -- <cmd>` on fast ephemeral sandboxes (APFS copy-on-write on macOS, tmpfs or reflink on Linux) is the execution path being designed to replace it; localhost NFS is a secondary exploration, not a day-one dependency.

repos.name: kin-bench
repos.note: Private benchmarking and proof-packaging harness. Kept private/trade-secret per IP strategy, not one of the open supporting repos.

repos.name: kin-bench-spec
repos.note: Public specification and standalone verifier for Kin's merge-trust benchmark. Open counterpart to the private kin-bench harness, whose runner and proof infrastructure stay proprietary.

repos.name: kin-lsp
repos.note: kin depends directly on the standalone kin-lsp repo.

repos.name: kin-actions
repos.note: Reusable GitHub Actions workflows for CI and release pipelines. Infrastructure/CI-only, not a product surface.

repos.name: homebrew-kin
repos.note: Homebrew tap carrying the kin formula. Delivery infrastructure that installs published kin release archives, not a product surface.

repos.name: kin-mcp
repos.note: MCP server surface exposing Kin semantic tools to AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Codex, Gemini). Bundled inside the kin repo as the kin-mcp crate (crates/kin-mcp) plus a published npm wrapper (packages/kin-mcp); not a standalone repo.
